content.title: Apollo to Sell Coinstar to Alaska Buyer, Bonds Set to Be Repaid
content.summary: The planned sale to Arctic Slope Regional Corp., created in 1972 as part of a US government settlement with the state’s indigenous residents, hasn’t been previously disclosed.  As part of the acquisition ASRC will repay more than $750 million of principal plus all interest in early January, according to a notice posted privately to owners of Coinstar’s bonds, known as whole business securitizations.  A spokesperson for Coinstar said it doesn’t comment on potential transactions, and Apollo declined to comment.
